name: excel_get_workbook_overview
description: Get workbook sheets, active sheet, used ranges, and current selection.

name: excel_read_range
description: Read values, formulas, and number formats from a range. Results larger than 5000 cells are truncated.

name: excel_summarize_range_stats
description: Compute deterministic numeric statistics for a range: count, numericCount, sum, average, min, max, and blankCount.

name: excel_write_range
description: Write a 2D array to a range. Strings beginning with = are written as formulas.

name: excel_format_range
description: Format a range with font, fill, number format, borders, alignment, and autofit options. Use CenterAcrossSelection to span a title across columns without merging.

horizontalAlignment.description: Horizontal alignment. CenterAcrossSelection formats a single-row multi-cell span without merging.

fontName.description: Font family name such as Calibri or Arial.

wrapText.description: Whether to wrap text in the range.

textOrientation.description: Text orientation in degrees, typically -90 to 90.

borderColor.description: Border color hex (overrides default border color when borders=true).

name: excel_conditional_format_range
description: Apply conditional formatting to a range using common rule types.

name: excel_freeze_panes
description: Freeze rows or columns in a worksheet.

name: excel_set_data_validation
description: Apply data validation rules to a range.

name: excel_create_sheet
description: Create a worksheet.

name: excel_delete_sheet
description: Delete a worksheet.

name: excel_activate_sheet
description: Activate a worksheet.

name: excel_insert_table
description: Create an Excel table from a range.

name: excel_sort_table
description: Sort a table by zero-based column index.

name: excel_filter_table
description: Filter a table column by values or a custom criterion such as >1000.

name: excel_create_chart
description: Create a chart next to a data range.

chartType.description: Excel chart type such as ColumnClustered, Line, Pie, BarClustered.

name: excel_find_replace
description: Find and replace text within the used range of a sheet.

name: excel_clear_range
description: Clear all contents and formats from a range.

name: excel_autofill_formula
description: Fill formulas from a source cell down or across a target range.

sourceAddress.description: Single-cell address with the formula to copy, such as E2.

name: excel_rename_sheet
description: Rename a worksheet.

name: excel_copy_sheet
description: Copy a worksheet to a new name within the same workbook.

name: excel_protect_sheet
description: Protect a worksheet. Password is never logged or stored; if the user did not provide a password, protect without one.

password.description: Optional password. If omitted, protect without a password.

name: excel_unprotect_sheet
description: Unprotect a worksheet.

password.description: Optional password. Required only if the sheet was protected with one.

name: excel_create_pivot_table
description: Create a pivot table from a source range. Returns an informative error if the Excel version does not support pivot creation through Office.js.

sheet.description: Target sheet name where the pivot table is created.

address.description: Top-left cell address for the pivot table output, such as A3.

sourceRange.description: Source data A1 address such as A1:D100. Must include headers.

rowFields.description: Column names to use as row fields.

columnFields.description: Column names to use as column fields.

name: excel_run_calculation
description: Recalculate the workbook.

name: excel_add_comment
description: Add or update a comment (note) on a specific cell.

address.description: Single-cell A1 address such as C5.

name: excel_clear_comments
description: Delete all comments (notes) in a range.

address.description: A1 address of the range to clear comments from.

name: excel_import_csv_to_sheet
description: Parse a CSV string and write the resulting 2D data array into a worksheet starting at the given address.

address.description: Top-left cell address to place the CSV data, such as A1.

csv.description: CSV data as a plain-text string. Delimiter auto-detection tries comma, tab, semicolon, pipe in order. The first row is treated as headers (bolded) by default when hasHeaders is true.

hasHeaders.description: Whether the first CSV row contains column headers (default true). If true, the header row is bolded. Note: delimiter auto-detection tries comma, tab, semicolon, pipe in order.

name: excel_execute_plan
description: Submit one bounded WorkbookPlan for deterministic inspect-or-execute handling. Use one static function call only in plan mode.

parameters.title: WorkbookPlan V1
parameters.description: Static model-facing contract for bounded, non-destructive Excel plans.

version.description: Plan schema version. Only version 1 is valid.
